source: English Indices of Deprivation 2019 and Office for National Statistics Labour Force Survey via Nomis
interpretation: Higher values indicate stronger observed social need under this simple project formula. The result is an exploratory index, not a percentage, an official statistic or a measure of Fusion21 impact.
aggregation_method: Raw social need index = (population-weighted mean IMD score + regional unemployment rate) / 2. Neither input is Min-Max standardised. The two inputs have different units and numerical ranges, so this is a simple descriptive combination rather than a balanced causal model.
